violation_type.title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(3))
violation_type.short_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records
violation_type.typical_finding: The person in charge did not have access to personnel records.

finding_variants.text: The person in charge did not have access to personnel records.
During inspection, caregivers in charge did not have access to all records during director's absence from center.

The person in charge during the inspection did not have access to the personnel and training records requested for reviewed.    This was corrected during the inspection when the director was contacted and direct the staff to gather the information needed.
Staff and children's records were unavailable for review during the inspection.
The assistant did not have access to staff trainings.

During inspection there was a caregiver in ratio with children, she was unable to leave the classroom and get documents that were required during the inspection.    This was corrected when two other caregivers arrived to the center and the person in charge was able to get me the documents.
